subject: general
question: Ascariasis, a disease caused due to which of the following helminths, is known to be pathogenic to man?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Common round worms.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

 
• **Ascariasis**

 
 
• It is a disease caused by **Common roundworms.**

 
 
• Common Roundworm is a type of parasitic helminth.
 
 
 
• Ascariasis is an infection of the small intestine caused by Ascaris lumbricoides, a species of roundworm.
